items.title: American Graffiti
items.line: George Lucas's film opened in the US on 11 August 1973. It cost $777,000, took about $140 million, and is set in Modesto on one night in 1962.

items.title: The oil embargo
items.line: The Arab oil embargo began in October 1973 and ran until March 1974. US petrol went from 38.5 cents a gallon in May 1973 to 55.1 cents in June 1974.

items.title: Secretariat
items.line: Won the Belmont Stakes on 9 June 1973 by 31 lengths in 2:24 flat, the first Triple Crown in 25 years.

items.title: The Battle of the Sexes
items.line: Billie Jean King beat Bobby Riggs 6–4, 6–3, 6–3 at the Houston Astrodome on 20 September 1973, for a $100,000 winner-take-all prize, in front of 30,472 people.

items.title: The Dark Side of the Moon
items.line: Released in the US on 1 March 1973. It spent 736 weeks on the Billboard chart in its original run and sold about 45 million copies.
